text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.
SOYOIL SALE - USDA said private exporters reported sales of 22,000 tonnes of soybean oil to China for delivery during the 1996/97 marketing year.
WHEAT SALE - USDA said private exporters reported sales of 150,000 tonnes of white wheat to Pakistan for delivery during the 1997/98 marketing year.
CORN TENDERS - Taiwan's CK group will tender on Tuesday for a 54,000-tonne shipment of U.S. No.2 corn. Shipment was slated for August 1-15, if U.S. Gulf.
- Taiwan's FGEP corn buying group will tender on Wednesday for a shipment of 54,000 tonnes of U.S. No.2 corn. Shipment was slated for September 1-15 shipment.
WHEAT TENDERS - The CCC on Tuesday seeks 60,000 tonnes of US HRW wheat for July 16-31 shipment for donation to Kyrgyzstan.
SOYMEAL TENDER - The CCC was scheduled to tender July 2 for 4,560 tonnes of U.S. soymeal for donation to Guatemala. Shipment is for July 17-31.

MARKET TALK - Algeria will stay out of the wheat market for a while after its reported decision last week to import 275,000 tonnes amid falling world prices, an Algerian cereals authority official said on Monday.
"There is no import tender for the coming days or weeks," the official told Reuters by telephone from Algiers.
